events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed the Radio Star' as its very first broadcast video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Remember when MTV actually played music videos? Forty-five years ago today, the channel that changed everything for artists and fans launched.

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years since the legendary event
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15–18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, leaving behind an unparalleled legacy as 'The King of Rock and Roll'.

angles.name: The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost The King. Elvis Presley's music and influence continue to resonate across generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today. She was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today. He was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: LG Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: License to thrill! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years of 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 86th birthday of music legend John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British actor and comedian John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today. He was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?
